source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 30 April 1930, p. 15 ("Clogher Council"); Ulster Herald, 26 April 1930, p. 5 ("Local Government Elections: Nominations in Tyrone")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 'Mr. R. J. Campbell having withdrawn his nomination, Mr. J. J. M'Mahon (Nationalist) has been returned unopposed for Ballygawley' (Belfast News-Letter, 30 April 1930, p. 15)

note: Triennial election of the Clogher rural district councillors, 1930. Fifteen divisions were settled at the nominations (Ulster Herald, 26 April 1930, p. 5); the one possible contest, Ballygawley, ended with R. J. Campbell's withdrawal (Belfast News-Letter, 30 April 1930, p. 15). Errigal had no nominations and no member is named for it, so it is not recorded. No poll was held; Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 4 June 1930. R. J. Campbell (U.) was also nominated and withdrew. Returned unopposed.
